notes: One sample per mode; manual orchestration in a live DSH session.
Total wall clock is 37% slower for the swarm on this three-module workload; the <=70% target is NOT met.

The two runs wrote different numbers of tests (7 vs 5), so quality is equal pass rate, not identical coverage.
